name: pipecat-context-hub
description: Set up Context Hub, explore voice-agent ideas, build locally and prepare approved Cloud deployments with grounded Pipecat sources.

interface.longDescription: Set up Pipecat tools, explore voice-agent ideas using sourced Context Hub documentation and examples, build apps and prepare approved Pipecat Cloud deployments. Requires native command execution and a compatible Python runtime in the task environment. Setup guides authorised CLI installation and initial indexing; deployment additionally requires a Pipecat Cloud account and login. Plugin installation supplies skills and assets, not the runtime or index.
